tagline: Find government schemes you qualify for. Free, private, in Hindi and English.

home.hero_title: Find the government schemes built for your family.
home.hero_subtitle: Answer a few simple questions or upload your papers. In under 2 minutes, see which schemes match you, which documents you need, and where to apply.
home.step1_desc: Tap through 6 to 8 simple questions, or upload a marksheet or income certificate.
home.step2_desc: We check every verified rule and highlight the top schemes with exact rupee benefits.
home.step3_desc: Tick off your documents, read numbered steps, and open the official website directly.
home.fraud_body: Apply only on official .gov.in websites or at an authorised Jan Seva Kendra (CSC). Never pay an agent for a free government form, and never share your OTP.

faq.a: Yes. Checking schemes, reading your documents, and asking Sahayak are completely free.

faq.q: Do I need to enter my Aadhaar or PAN number?
faq.a: No. We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN, or bank account numbers. If your uploaded paper has them, we hide them automatically before AI reads anything.

faq.q: Can I use it without uploading any document?
faq.a: Yes. Use Find Schemes to answer simple tap questions — no PDF needed.

faq.q: What if I only have photos on my phone?
faq.a: You can upload PDFs or clear JPG/PNG photos, and edit any detail we read.
All Central Government schemes (all India) plus Uttar Pradesh state schemes. Citizens from any state can check all Central schemes.

faq.q: Can I apply directly on this website?
faq.a: No. We are an independent helper. We help you check eligibility and prepare papers, then send you to the official .gov.in portal.

wizard.title: Find Schemes for Me
wizard.subtitle: One quick question at a time. No Aadhaar or ID number needed.
wizard.q_state: Which state or Union Territory do you live in?
wizard.why_state: Why we ask: Central schemes cover all of India; state schemes depend on your residence.
wizard.why_age: Why we ask: Many scholarships, loans, and pensions have minimum or maximum age limits.
wizard.why_role: Why we ask: Helps us highlight schemes meant for students, farmers, workers, or seniors.
wizard.why_category: Why we ask: Several scholarships and business loans reserve extra support by category.
wizard.why_gender: Why we ask: Some scholarships and family schemes are specifically for women and girls.
wizard.why_income: Why we ask: Most welfare schemes check whether family income is below a yearly limit.
wizard.why_education: Why we ask: Pre-matric, Class 12, and college scholarships have different rules.
wizard.why_marks: Why we ask: Merit scholarships require minimum marks (such as 50%, 60%, or 80%).
wizard.q_disability: Do you have a benchmark disability (UDID)?
wizard.why_disability: Why we ask: Unlocks assistive device grants and dedicated disability scholarships.
wizard.state_note: State-specific schemes are currently covered for Uttar Pradesh. For all other states and UTs, Central Government schemes are shown below.
wizard.no_results: No schemes matched those filters. Try clearing one filter or browsing All Schemes.

docs.title: My Documents
docs.subtitle: Upload PDFs or clear photos of your certificates. ID numbers, phones, and emails are hidden automatically before AI reads anything.
docs.drop_title: Choose a PDF or photo (JPG, PNG)
docs.drop_hint: Up to 10 files, 15 MB each. Kept only for this visit.
docs.missing_marks_hint: Marksheet not uploaded yet — upload one to check marks-based scholarships.
docs.missing_income_hint: Income certificate not uploaded yet — upload one to check income limits.
